scope: Native character save contract, complete MapService snapshot replay and awaited cash bonus item dispatch. Functional persistence repairs, no new gameplay rewards/formulas.
implemented: Migration 041 persists native @StatLevel/@StatPoint/@StatExp into bStatLevel/bStatPoint/dwStatExp. The C# DTO already passed these values; the inherited procedure discarded them. The disposable SQL test first reproduces the unchanged old columns, applies the repair, then reloads the intended values through a fresh connection.

The same migration removes the inherited name-specific TEventItemGive branch and its TGROUP credential reads from TSaveChar. Ordinary saving no longer issues a special item to one named character. Known procedure anchors are checked, changes are transactional, unexpected contracts fail, and applying twice leaves the same definition.

Journaled SaveCharAsync now checks the native TSaveChar return value as well as missing-procedure failures. A rejected/missing character cannot acknowledge its snapshot or proceed to create orphan auxiliary rows. Non-strict existing callers retain their earlier behavior.

Cash bonus item use now records consumption before starting the cash procedure and awaits it on the serialized batch dispatch. Earlier fire-and-forget work could outlive dispatch/logout and flush pre-consumption item state. Normal item acknowledgements, cooldowns, quest hooks and existing cash failure handling remain.
